description: This is a PHP template file used for rendering an admin interface form to edit story details in a web application's CMS. It includes form fields for various story attributes such as project, language, title, review, description, post, URL, images, display options, and classification details, with embedded PHP code for dynamic content rendering.

classes.name: Story
classes.description: The story object representing the story being edited, with properties like id, title, description, url, and methods to get images and other attributes.

methods.name: getListTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of story protagonist types for selection in the form.
